description: Prompt Flow's @trace functions around two chat calls (a tool call, then the answer), exported through its own OTLP setup.
notes: Prompt Flow's tracing (promptflow-tracing 1.18.5, promptflow-devkit 1.18.5) in its own environment: envs/promptflow pins opentelemetry-sdk 1.38.0 because promptflow-tracing needs opentelemetry-sdk<1.39 (D-IN-26 item 1). The program calls setup_exporter_from_environ() from promptflow.tracing._start_trace, the path the docs give, with OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT set to the full traces URL: Prompt Flow posts to that URL as given. The @trace functions are flow (the root, span_type Function) and get_weather (a tool, span_type Function). Prompt Flow's OpenAI injection makes each chat call an LLM span (openai_chat). The mock serves a tool-call turn and a text turn. The client's base URL is the mock, and the scenario reads no content variable.

message.text: It is 18 °C and sunny in Paris.
